purpose: Opt-in descriptive comparison of DRA visual-generation routes on fixed representative cases.

cases.fixed_input: Create a responsive launch page for a privacy-first team knowledge product. Use realistic product copy, one primary call to action, one proof section, one workflow section and one pricing teaser. Avoid generic gradient hero art and excessive cards.

Create a desktop operations dashboard for support leads. Show queue health, breached-SLA risk, agent workload and a clear next action using realistic data. Preserve a calm, precise working density and avoid decorative metrics without an action path.

Create a dense desktop investigation workbench with a primary results table, filters, saved views, row inspection and bulk actions. Use realistic data and error/empty/loading states. Keep the table as the primary work object and avoid nested cards.

Create a four-screen mobile flow for recording and submitting a reimbursable expense: capture, review, policy warning and success. Include keyboard, permission-denied, offline recovery and reduced-motion conditions with realistic copy.

Create a reusable date-range and comparison control with keyboard/touch operation, presets, custom range, invalid range, loading, disabled and compact states. Show anatomy, variants, feedback and responsive behavior without drawing each instance as a separate style.

Create a component workbench for a reusable data-table family with density, selection, sorting, inline editing, column management, empty/loading/error and accessibility states. Demonstrate shared family grammar, tokens, slots and composition.

Create one responsive project-planning page at compact mobile, tablet and wide desktop sizes. Preserve information priority, primary actions and realistic content while showing reflow, overflow, touch/keyboard and text-scale behavior.

Redesign only an existing invoice review panel using the supplied UI library, tokens and component owners. Preserve the surrounding page, reuse existing families where feasible, show approval/rejection/error states and identify any genuine component gap without inventing a parallel visual system.
